scope: native Windows dead-root disposition contract tests; no production code change
resolution: Two old tests expected silent record deletion after root exit. Preserve both actual waited/unwaited exit scenarios but require nonzero unconfirmed stop, no termination calls and unchanged record. Pin identity with a verified handle; coordinate exit instead of fixed sleep or PID-reuse skips. Both tests are required by the Windows JUnit gate.
compatibility: Abnormal Windows root exit now requires operator review, including no visible descendants. This is explicit fail-closed hardening, not transparent behavior compatibility.
